consumers.evidence: Current product sources define in-task preview, truthful format support, preserved download, authenticated access, allowed roots, cleanup behavior, and active-content blocking.
THREAD-FILE-PREVIEW-001 remains user_confirmed with office conversion, editing, collaboration, and permanent storage deferred.
Plain local-path navigation is replaced only for validated task references; external links remain external and no competing arbitrary-file endpoint or active-content renderer exists.
Thread hydration, preview grants, authenticated delivery, Markdown components, modal state, responsive layout, and client types are integrated.
The implemented chain is thread open to canonical referenced-file validation to opaque token to authenticated response to in-task overlay and download.
Runtime supports image, PDF, text, and download-only presentation with desktop modal and mobile full-screen behavior.
Implementation uses existing Node, Express, React, ReactMarkdown, and Lucide capabilities with no new dependency or conversion runtime.
The in-memory registry owns random time-limited grants; every response requires a trusted-device session and missing, expired, moved, or deleted files fail closed.
Only thread cwd and the existing upload root authorize files; existing 24-hour cleanup remains unchanged and no permanent index or new configuration is created.

Automated and browser checks cover reference and root validation, authentication, expiry, active-content blocking, removal, inline text and image, unsupported formats, download, responsive layout, scroll restoration, and regressions.
